rationale: Both miss the two most significant confirmed bugs (High-severity slot leak, Medium-latent ceil-division bug), and neither surfaces the hsliuustc0106 legacy-checkpoint model_type collision cleanly. X actively asserts the slot-leak is 'handled' via on_requests_finished — a confidently false claim that directly contradicts a ground-truth-confirmed, author-fixed High bug, which is a real precision problem. Y is more evidence-driven, citing concrete greps for its top findings (e.g., put_req_chunk never incremented, directly tied to the new initial_codec_chunk_frames feature visible in the diff) and gives explicit fix suggestions, though it also contains a self-contradictory/mislocated finding on max_new_frames and one vague unverified claim. Y's rigor and explicit fix guidance make it slightly more trustworthy and actionable overall.
